keyPoints.en: Cell division is needed for growth, repair, replacing dead cells and reproduction.
keyPoints.bm: Pembahagian sel diperlukan untuk pertumbuhan, pembaikan, menggantikan sel mati dan pembiakan.

keyPoints.en: Chromosomes carry DNA. Before division each chromosome is copied into two sister chromatids joined at a centromere.
keyPoints.bm: Kromosom membawa DNA. Sebelum pembahagian, setiap kromosom disalin kepada dua kromatid beradik yang disambung pada sentromer.

keyPoints.en: Human body cells are diploid (2n = 46); gametes are haploid (n = 23).
keyPoints.bm: Sel badan manusia diploid (2n = 46); gamet haploid (n = 23).

keyPoints.en: Two types: mitosis (body cells) and meiosis (gamete-forming cells in testes and ovaries).
keyPoints.bm: Dua jenis: mitosis (sel badan) dan meiosis (sel pembentuk gamet dalam testis dan ovari).

question.en: A dog has 78 chromosomes in its body cells. How many are in its egg cells?
question.bm: Anjing mempunyai 78 kromosom dalam sel badannya. Berapa dalam sel telurnya?

keyPoints.en: Cell cycle: interphase (G1 growth → S DNA replication → G2 preparation) then M phase (mitosis + cytokinesis).
keyPoints.bm: Kitar sel: interfasa (G1 pertumbuhan → S replikasi DNA → G2 persediaan) kemudian fasa M (mitosis + sitokinesis).

keyPoints.en: Prophase: chromosomes condense, nuclear membrane disappears, spindle forms.
keyPoints.bm: Profasa: kromosom memendek, membran nukleus hilang, gelendong terbentuk.

keyPoints.en: Metaphase: chromosomes line up at the equator. Anaphase: sister chromatids pulled apart to the poles.
keyPoints.bm: Metafasa: kromosom tersusun di khatulistiwa. Anafasa: kromatid beradik ditarik ke kutub.

keyPoints.en: Telophase: nuclear membranes re-form. Cytokinesis: cleavage furrow (animal) or cell plate (plant).
keyPoints.bm: Telofasa: membran nukleus terbentuk semula. Sitokinesis: alur pembelahan (haiwan) atau plat sel (tumbuhan).

keyPoints.en: Result: 2 genetically identical diploid daughter cells. Used in tissue culture and cloning.
keyPoints.bm: Hasil: 2 sel anak diploid yang seiras secara genetik. Digunakan dalam kultur tisu dan pengklonan.

question.en: Why is it important that daughter cells from mitosis are identical?
question.bm: Mengapa sel anak hasil mitosis perlu seiras?

answer.en: So new cells in tissues can do exactly the same job and carry the same genetic information.
answer.bm: Supaya sel baharu dalam tisu dapat menjalankan tugas yang sama dan membawa maklumat genetik yang sama.

keyPoints.en: Meiosis happens in the testes and ovaries (anthers and ovules in plants) to make gametes.
keyPoints.bm: Meiosis berlaku dalam testis dan ovari (anter dan ovul dalam tumbuhan) untuk menghasilkan gamet.

keyPoints.en: Meiosis I: homologous chromosomes pair up, cross over, then separate → 2 haploid cells.
keyPoints.bm: Meiosis I: kromosom homolog berpasangan, pindah silang, kemudian berpisah → 2 sel haploid.

keyPoints.en: Meiosis II: sister chromatids separate (like mitosis) → 4 haploid cells.
keyPoints.bm: Meiosis II: kromatid beradik berpisah (seperti mitosis) → 4 sel haploid.

keyPoints.en: Genetic variation comes from crossing over and independent assortment of chromosomes.
keyPoints.bm: Variasi genetik terhasil daripada pindah silang dan penyusunan bebas kromosom.

keyPoints.en: Meiosis keeps the chromosome number constant across generations.
keyPoints.bm: Meiosis mengekalkan bilangan kromosom yang malar merentas generasi.

question.en: Give two differences between mitosis and meiosis.
question.bm: Berikan dua perbezaan antara mitosis dan meiosis.

answer.en: Mitosis: 1 division, 2 identical diploid cells. Meiosis: 2 divisions, 4 different haploid cells (with crossing over).
answer.bm: Mitosis: 1 pembahagian, 2 sel diploid seiras. Meiosis: 2 pembahagian, 4 sel haploid berbeza (dengan pindah silang).

tip.en: Make a comparison table: number of divisions, cells formed, chromosome number, crossing over, where it happens.
tip.bm: Buat jadual perbandingan: bilangan pembahagian, sel terbentuk, bilangan kromosom, pindah silang, tempat berlaku.

keyPoints.en: Cancer: genes controlling the cell cycle are damaged, so cells divide uncontrollably and form a tumour.
keyPoints.bm: Kanser: gen yang mengawal kitar sel rosak, jadi sel membahagi tanpa kawalan dan membentuk tumor.

keyPoints.en: Carcinogens: tobacco smoke, UV light, X-rays, some chemicals and viruses (e.g. HPV).
keyPoints.bm: Karsinogen: asap rokok, cahaya UV, sinar-X, sesetengah bahan kimia dan virus (cth. HPV).

keyPoints.en: Treatment: surgery, radiotherapy, chemotherapy. Prevention: no smoking, sunscreen, healthy diet, screening.
keyPoints.bm: Rawatan: pembedahan, radioterapi, kemoterapi. Pencegahan: tidak merokok, pelindung matahari, diet sihat, saringan.

keyPoints.en: Non-disjunction in meiosis gives abnormal chromosome numbers: Down syndrome (47, trisomy 21), Turner (45, XO), Klinefelter (47, XXY).
keyPoints.bm: Tak disjunksi dalam meiosis menghasilkan bilangan kromosom abnormal: sindrom Down (47, trisomi 21), Turner (45, XO), Klinefelter (47, XXY).

question.en: Why is the HPV vaccine given to Form 1 girls in Malaysia?
question.bm: Mengapa vaksin HPV diberikan kepada pelajar perempuan Tingkatan 1 di Malaysia?

answer.en: It prevents HPV infection, which can cause cervical cancer.
answer.bm: Ia mencegah jangkitan HPV yang boleh menyebabkan kanser serviks.

tip.en: Cancer = MITOSIS gone wrong. Down syndrome = MEIOSIS gone wrong.
tip.bm: Kanser = MITOSIS bermasalah. Sindrom Down = MEIOSIS bermasalah.
